say: This is a real run on soltao. The stake page, next to a Solana wallet.
Sign in once. That signature moves no funds. The browser makes your Bittensor wallet.
Then choose what happens on arrival. Stake it, or just deliver it.
Every fee is on the page before you sign. soltao's fee, the bridge, and the wallet it lands in.
One Solana transaction starts it. From here, the page does the rest.
Solana is done. The bridge is delivering the TAO. Then the page unwraps it into your wallet.
It has landed. The TAO is in the Bittensor wallet this page made. Try it at soltao dot x y z.
